description: make example EX=apb: APB3 master + register file (apb_tb.sv). Hand-written: views, signal lists, bookmarks and arrows; the Makefile passes the dump with --waves.

page.title: APB3 · write, read with wait states, slave error
page.intro: An APB3 master drives a four-register slave: a write to 0x04, a read of 0x04 that the slave stretches with two wait states, and a write to the unmapped address 0x40 that ends with PSLVERR.

transfers.title: APB3 · three transfers · clock-sampled
transfers.note: one cell per PCLK; the numbered bookmarks explain the transfers, the arrows join cause and effect

bookmarks.text: SETUP: PSEL high, PADDR / PWRITE / PWDATA valid for the whole transfer
ACCESS: PENABLE high; PREADY high ends the write in this cycle
two wait states: the slave holds PREADY low, the master keeps every signal

bookmarks.label: 0xCAFE0001
bookmarks.text: read data 0xCAFE0001 is valid with PREADY

bookmarks.label: unmapped
bookmarks.text: 0x40 is not mapped in the register file
PSLVERR with PREADY: the transfer failed

write.note: the same data as a static figure, with the bookmark texts as a legend; two of the bound assertions drawn under it (svaShow)

bookmarks.text: SETUP: address, direction and data valid
